summary: A Fourth Judicial District grand jury indicted a woman on a first-degree burglary count on Oct. 6, replacing a lesser burglary charge on the same count. A man under indictment on two Class C felonies failed to appear at a Fairbanks hearing the same afternoon and a warrant was issued at $5,000. Charges were filed over a conditions-of-release referral that troopers made on Oct. 5, and a warrant was issued on that case as well. Troopers forwarded an assault charge over a Fairbanks disturbance with no arrest and no court file, and referred a 16-year-old to the Division of Juvenile Justice over a separate disturbance. The weekly filings counts below are the court report's own counts for the week ending Oct. 6, and that report added two cases to Monday, Oct. 5 after publishing that day as complete.

entries.title: Grand jury indicts woman on first-degree burglary count, replacing a lesser burglary charge
body: A Fourth Judicial District grand jury returned an indictment on Tuesday, Oct. 6 in a case filed at the Nenana court, and the count it returned on is more serious than the one originally charged.

The case is 4NE-26-00096CR, State of Alaska vs. Zappone, Krista Marie, filed Sep. 26 with a status of Reopened. Alaska CourtView records that the sixth count on the file was originally charged as burglary in the second degree, AS 11.46.310, a Class C felony. The indicted charge against that same count reads burglary in the first degree, in a dwelling, AS 11.46.300(a)(1), a Class B felony, with a stage date of Oct. 6. The offence location on the count is Denali National Park and the offence date is Sep. 25.

A seventh count was added to the file the same day by information: criminal trespass in the first degree, on land with intent to commit a crime, AS 11.46.320(a)(1), a Class A misdemeanour, also at Denali National Park.

The file's other five counts are unchanged and none carries an indicted charge: criminal trespass in the first degree in a dwelling, a Class A misdemeanour; theft in the fourth degree, a Class B misdemeanour; two counts of violating conditions of release, Class B misdemeanours; and a separate count of burglary in the first degree in a dwelling, a Class B felony. No count is recorded as domestic violence related. She is charged, not convicted.

The docket records the indictment filed in Superior Court with jurisdiction transferred, the indictment filed in open court, the information adding the misdemeanour count, and a felony pre-trial order effective Oct. 14. A Superior Court arraignment is set for Oct. 14 at 1:30 p.m. in Courtroom 402 before Judge Brent Bennett; a calendar call is set for Nov. 17 and a trial week for Nov. 30. Preliminary hearings that had stood for Oct. 6 and Oct. 15 are vacated.
The offences are recorded at Cantwell and in Denali National Park, outside the Fairbanks area; the case is carried because the defendant was remanded to the Fairbanks jail.

entries.title: Warrant issued at $5,000 after man charged with two felonies fails to appear
body: A man under indictment on two Class C felonies did not appear at a hearing in Fairbanks on Tuesday afternoon, and a warrant was issued for his arrest.

The case is 4DJ-26-00056CR, State of Alaska vs. Budnik, Pavel Ivanovich, filed Sep. 21 at the Delta Junction court. Alaska CourtView records a representation hearing set for Oct. 6 at 3:45 p.m. in Courtroom 404 before Judge Thomas Temple, with the result "Deft Failed to Appear. Warrant to Issue."

A docket entry of the same date records a warrant issued by the Delta Junction court with bail set at $5,000 appearance, 10 per cent posting required, and a direction that the defendant not be released until he appears before a judicial officer. The warrant was issued to the Alaska State Troopers and Judicial Services at Delta Junction and Fairbanks.

The file carries two counts, both offence-dated Sep. 20 at Delta Junction and both indicted by a grand jury on Sep. 29: terroristic threatening in the second degree, fear of serious injury, AS 11.56.810(a)(1)(A), a Class C felony; and assault in the third degree, cause fear of injury with a weapon, AS 11.41.220(a)(1)(A), a Class C felony. The second count was originally charged as violating a condition of release for a felony, a Class A misdemeanour. He is charged, not convicted.

No hearing now stands on the file. A Superior Court arraignment set for Oct. 7 is reset, a preliminary hearing set for Oct. 8 is vacated, and an omnibus hearing set for Dec. 1 and a trial week set for Dec. 14 are both now vacated. Nothing in the record describes the incident and nothing in it identifies any person recorded as a victim.

entries.title: Charges filed over a reported conditions-of-release violation, and a warrant issued
body: A criminal case has been filed over the reported conditions-of-release violation that Alaska State Troopers referred to the District Attorney's Office on Monday, and a warrant has been issued on it.

Alaska CourtView records 4FA-26-02026CR, State of Alaska vs. Eakin, Jess Lee Antonich, filed Oct. 5 with a status of Open. The file carries two counts, both offence-dated Oct. 5 at Fairbanks: violating conditions of release for a misdemeanour, AS 11.56.757(a)(misdB), a Class B misdemeanour; and unlawful contact per court order, AS 11.56.750(a)(1)(A), a Class A misdemeanour recorded as domestic violence related. No grand jury has heard the case. He is charged, not convicted.

The docket records the charging document and a warrant requested on Oct. 5, and a warrant issued on Oct. 6 with bail set at $500 cash performance and a direction that the defendant not be released until the court approves conditions of release. No hearing is calendared and no attorney is entered for the defendant.

The trooper dispatch for Oct. 5 gave the location as North Pole and recorded the second offence as unlawful contact in the first degree. The charging document records both counts at Fairbanks and records the lesser unlawful contact offence. Where the two records differ, the court file states what was charged.

The case was added to the Alaska Court System's weekly charges report in the run of Oct. 6, under the filing day of Monday, Oct. 5. The run of the night before did not contain it. Nothing in the record identifies any person recorded as a victim.

entries.title: Troopers forward an assault charge after a Fairbanks disturbance
body: The Alaska State Troopers dispatch records that at about 4:43 a.m. on Monday, Oct. 5 troopers in Fairbanks received a report of a disturbance, and that the investigation found that Megan Henderson, 42, of Fairbanks had assaulted a household member and then left the scene. The dispatch states that a charge of assault in the fourth degree was forwarded to the District Attorney's Office. The entry was posted at 4:20 a.m. on Oct. 6.

No arrest is recorded in the entry. No criminal court file exists: a search of Alaska CourtView under that name for cases filed since Sep. 1 returns no records, and no case recording that offence appears in the weekly charges report run on Oct. 6. The offence above is as recorded by police, and no charge class is stated here because none is on any court file.
Nothing in the record identifies any person recorded as a victim.

entries.title: Sixteen-year-old referred to juvenile justice after a Farmers Loop Road disturbance
body: The Alaska State Troopers dispatch records that at about 9:25 p.m. on Monday, Oct. 5 troopers responded to a domestic disturbance in the Farmers Loop Road area of Fairbanks, and that the investigation found a 16-year-old had committed the offences of harassment in the first degree, criminal mischief in the fourth degree and assault in the fourth degree.
The dispatch states that charges are being forwarded to the Division of Juvenile Justice for review and that the juvenile was relocated in the meantime. The entry was posted at 7:39 a.m. on Oct. 6.

The juvenile is not named. Juvenile matters referred to the Division of Juvenile Justice do not appear in the adult criminal court record, and no charge class is stated. Nothing in the record identifies any person recorded as a victim.

entries.title: Vehicle window broken at Fox; troopers record no suspects
body: Alaska State Troopers responded to a disturbance at 1255 Gilmore Trail at Fox, north of Fairbanks, at about 2:50 a.m. on Sep. 26. The dispatch states that the back window of a vehicle parked in a driveway had been broken by an unknown person, apparently by a piece of chain thrown through it.
The dispatch records that there are no suspects and that the incident is considered closed pending further evidence. No arrest has been made and no charge has been filed.
The entry was posted on Oct. 6, ten days after the night it describes.

entries.title: Assault report from Oct. 4 appears on the police bulletin three days later
body: The Fairbanks Police Department daily bulletin records an incident classified as simple assault at the 3500 block of Airport Way at about 1:03 a.m. on Sunday, Oct. 4, reported at 1:04 a.m. The case number is 26003040.

It is an incident report rather than an arrest. No suspect is named, no charge is recorded against it, and no court file carrying an assault on that date has been identified in the Alaska Court System's weekly charges report.
The bulletin returned no events for Oct. 4 when it was read on Oct. 4, Oct. 5 and Oct. 6. The entry appeared on Oct. 7.

entries.title: Police record a reported protective order violation on the Old Steese Highway
body: The Fairbanks Police Department daily bulletin records an incident classified as a domestic violence protective order violation at the 900 block of the Old Steese Highway at about 1:29 p.m. on Monday, Oct. 5. The case number is 26003052.

It is an incident report rather than an arrest. No suspect is named, no charge is recorded against it, and no corresponding court file has been identified. The entry was added to the bulletin after Oct. 6. Nothing in the record identifies any person recorded as a victim.

entries.title: Fairbanks woman charged with driving under the influence after an Illinois Street arrest
body: A criminal case was filed at Fairbanks on Tuesday, Oct. 6 over an arrest made the previous night. Alaska CourtView records 4FA-26-02025CR, State of Alaska vs. Briscoe, Angela Jean, status Open, with one count of driving under the influence, operate a vehicle under the influence of alcohol or drugs, AS 28.35.030(a), a Class A misdemeanour, offence-dated Oct. 5 at Fairbanks. She is charged, not convicted.

The Fairbanks Police Department daily bulletin records the arrest at the 200 block of Illinois Street at Church Street at 11:04 p.m. on Oct. 5, case 26003057, and records the charge as driving under the influence with a breath alcohol level of .08 or over. The count on the court file is the general impairment subsection rather than the subsection that turns on the reading; the class above is the one on the court file.
An arraignment is set for Oct. 13 at 8:30 a.m. in Courtroom 102. The case judge is Bahr.

entries.title: Court number issued over a Dunkel Street arrest, with no charge filed against it
body: A court case number was issued at Fairbanks on Tuesday, Oct. 6 over an arrest made the previous afternoon, and no charge has been filed against it. Alaska CourtView records 4FA-26-02024CR, State of Alaska vs. Tunik Jr, Ronald, status Open, with one count recorded as charging document pending or not filed and no degree of offence, offence-dated Oct. 5 at Fairbanks.

The Fairbanks Police Department daily bulletin records the arrest at the 100 block of Dunkel Street at 1:37 p.m. on Oct. 5 on a charge recorded by police as disorderly conduct, creating a hazardous condition. No charge class is stated here, because the police record is not a charging document.
An order and conditions of release were entered on Oct. 6 and an arraignment is set for Oct. 13 at 8:30 a.m. The case judge is Christian. He is arrested, not convicted.

entries.title: Licence charge filed over a North Pole stop in September
body: A criminal case filed at Fairbanks on Oct. 5 over an offence last month has appeared in the court record. Alaska CourtView records 4FA-26-02027CR, State of Alaska vs. Martin, Wyatt Andrew Mumford, status Open, with one count of driving with a licence cancelled, suspended or revoked with a prior conviction, AS 28.15.291(a)(2), a Class A misdemeanour, offence-dated Sep. 17 at North Pole. He is charged, not convicted.
An arraignment is set for Oct. 13 at 8:30 a.m. in Courtroom 102. The case judge is Bahr.
The case appears in no trooper dispatch entry and no police bulletin line. North Pole operates no public incident feed, so cases arising there reach the public only when a court file is opened.

entries.title: A case number opened on Tuesday with no charge and no docket entry is arraigned on Wednesday
body: A court case number was issued at Fairbanks on Tuesday, Oct. 6 with no charge filed against it and no docket entry of any kind. Alaska CourtView records 4FA-26-02028CR, State of Alaska vs. Knight, Daniel Owen, status Open, with one count recorded as charging document pending or not filed and no degree of offence, offence-dated Oct. 6 at Fairbanks.
An arraignment is set for Oct. 7 at 1:30 p.m. in Courtroom 102. The case judge is Bahr. No charge class is stated, because none is on the file.

The case appears in no record other than the court file: the trooper dispatch for Oct. 6 carries four entries and none of them is this, and the Fairbanks Police Department daily bulletin returned no events for Oct. 6.

entries.title: Bail hearing held in a Fairbanks felony drink-driving case, with a second set for Oct. 9
body: A bail hearing was held on Tuesday, Oct. 6 at 2:15 p.m. in Courtroom 304 before Judge Kirk Schwalm in 4FA-26-02011CR, State of Alaska vs. Baker, Tal Xavier. The docket records an application for first bail review filed the same day, counsel entered, and a temporary order with conditions of release.

The file carries one count of felony driving under the influence with two or more prior convictions, AS 28.35.030(n), a Class C felony, offence-dated Oct. 3 at Fairbanks, with a breath alcohol reading of .085 recorded against it. He is charged, not convicted.
A second bail hearing is set for Oct. 9 at 9:30 a.m. in the same courtroom, and preliminary hearings are set for Oct. 13 and Oct. 22.

entries.title: Five arraignments continued in five days in a Fairbanks misdemeanour case, with a sixth set for Wednesday
body: Alaska CourtView records five consecutive arraignments marked Hearing Continued in 4FA-26-01995CR, State of Alaska vs. Tubin, Amber Nicole, on Oct. 2, Oct. 3, Oct. 4, Oct. 5 and Oct. 6, with a temporary order and conditions of release re-entered after most of them. A sixth arraignment is set for Oct. 7 at 1:30 p.m. in Courtroom 102.

The file carries three counts, all offence-dated Oct. 1 at Fairbanks: assault in the fourth degree, recklessly injure, and harassment in the first degree, offensive contact with fluids, both Class A misdemeanours; and criminal trespass in the second degree, upon premises, a Class B misdemeanour. None is recorded as domestic violence related. She is charged, not convicted.
Private counsel entered on Oct. 6. A pre-trial conference is set for Dec. 3 and a trial week for Dec. 14.

entries.title: The court's weekly filings report adds two cases to a Monday it had already published as complete
body: The Alaska Court System publishes a weekly report of criminal charges filed, covering a rolling seven days. The run of Monday, Oct. 5 at 9 p.m. carried two Fairbanks cases under the filing day of Monday, Oct. 5. The run of Tuesday, Oct. 6 at 9:01 p.m. carries four.
The two additions are 4FA-26-02026CR and 4FA-26-02027CR. Both carry a court file date of Oct. 5 on the court's own record, and both have docket entries dated Oct. 5.

Filing-day counts taken from that report are the counts as they stood at the time the report was run. The report has now been seen to add cases to a filing day one, three and four days after that day closed.
